title: impl_string_enum_serde! does not generate Display; Display still manually repeated
description: submission.rs has Delivered, Displayed, UndoStatus — each with Serialize+Deserialize via the macro but Display still manually written. Each Display impl repeats the same match arms as the macro-generated Serialize. Adding a new variant requires touching both the macro invocation and the manual Display impl. Suggested rewrite: extend impl_string_enum_serde! to also emit impl fmt::Display, eliminating the separate Display blocks entirely.
